reviewDecisions.rationale: A genuine cross-border accessibility state changed before actual launch. Deep research should test whether ownership-base repricing can be evidenced without inventing a direct earnings bridge.
The enforcement shock may redistribute value toward compliant firms. Deep research must search company-quality exceptions rather than treat the whole NEV sector uniformly.
The new rule produced observable freight-rate changes within days. Deep research should separate legal-capacity beneficiaries, modal substitutes and cargo-cost losers.
The event arrived after the Sep-30 close and changes leverage/demand conditions. Deep research should test defensive company exceptions and avoid generic property-beta assumptions.
The global DRAM inflection is fresh and economically real; the A-share map must still fail closed unless direct current product earnings exist.
Coal scarcity remains strong but the core restriction is a continuation and policy is already counter-adjusting supply. This is a direct guardrail test that V1.9 fresh escalation remains unavailable.
